stories.title: Jerify Magnetic Stick Figure Toys Recalled — 38,507 Units, Children Hospitalized

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
RECALL: Jerify stick figure toys pulled from Amazon. 2 kids hospitalized after swallowing detached magnets.

38,507 sets sold 2022–2026. Stop use. Contact Colerinsec for refund.

cpsc.gov #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jerify stick figure toy magnets detach and can be swallowed.

Swallowed magnets attract through gut walls — perforations, blockage, or death.

Amazon buyers: search Jerify or Colerinsec. Sold Oct 2022–May 2026. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
